<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Hmmm? Who do we have here? Are you a friend
of <$cdef(27)>’s?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Well, <$cdef(27)> just so happens to be a
good
friend
of
mine
as well!
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,39)>I’d be very happy if you and I could be friends too!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,6)>This is such a splendid smell. I didn’t even realize I was
following it back home!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)><$cdef(27)>! I was so worried—I thought
you’d
disappeared
somewhere
like the
humans did...
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,39)>It’s such a relief to see you! Oh, happy day!

<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>This <$cdef(27)> turned out
quite nicely!

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>This <$cdef(27)> is fantastic! I’m
having
such
a
jolly
time
just
admiring it!

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>! I see you’re working hard
first
thing
in
the morning!

<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>I find afternoons to be perfect for relaxing. Why don’t you
take a little break, <$cdef(27)>?

<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Take care to watch your footing now that it’s getting
dark, <$cdef(27)>.

<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,668)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)>Nighttime can really be exciting. I often find myself staying
up far later than I intended!

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>If you’ve ever got a problem, remember you can always
come talk to me!

<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)><$pkcry;0(1,3)>... I wonder what the humans are up to
right
now,
wherever
they are...<$comcan(1)>

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>I can never predict what you’re going to do next,
<$cdef(27)>!
It’s
really
quite fascinating!

<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,660)><$voicel(1,1)><$pkcry;0(1,4)>... I think I’ve got a knot in my vines
somewhere.

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,659)><$voicel(1,9)>I’m looking forward to this <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>ing project! Just make
sure you’re all prepared!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>, was it? How can I help you?<$motion(1,652)>
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,659)>These trusty vines of mine make demolition a cinch!

<$voicel(1,3)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,660)>I’m already plenty peckish, and we haven’t even started...
I hope we begin soon!

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hm? Oh, you’ve already got what I was asking for! I don’t
suppose you’d share?
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>All right. I apologize for asking so suddenly like that.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Hmmm?! Don’t tell me you’ve already made it?

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>What’s that you say? Have you actually gotten it for
me already?
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>What’s that you say? Have you actually done it already?

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Thank you, <$cdef(27)>! This makes me
very happy.

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,7)>What’s this? You’ve already made just what I was asking
for? I don’t suppose you have extra you could share?

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Thank you, <$cdef(27)>! This makes me
very happy.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)>You’re always working so hard, <$cdef(27)>.
I wanted
to
give
you
this
present
as thanks!

<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,667)><$voicel(1,3)>Hrmmm, that looks like a few too many Pokémon for a
casual stroll. <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>I’d rather not add to the crowd!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)>Can we do that later? So sorry, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,659)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>! I’m having a grand time <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>ing</color>!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,8)>Let’s be off, then!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>I suppose that’s it for now, then! I’ll see you
around, <$cdef(27)>!

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,660)><$facial(1,9)>I’m so, so hungry... I’m afraid I don’t have the strength to
follow you.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,660)><$facial(1,9)>Urk... I’m so hungry I can’t move...

<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,7)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,3)>Cut that out, <$cdef(27)>! You wouldn’t
want
someone
to
get hurt!

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,668)><$voicel(1,8)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>! ♪ Don’t let me stop you—that feels
quite nice!

<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hm? Did you do something just
now, <$cdef(27)>?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,29)>Hmmm? What could this be? I think it’s worth
investigating, <$cdef(27)>!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,659)><$pkcry;0(1,1)>! <$pkcry;1(1,2)>! Leave this demolition
project
to me!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,5)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>. This sure smells good. I’m getting
awfully
eager
to eat!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,659)><$voicel(1,10)>Parties really ARE fun!

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,668)><$voicel(1,9)>Ahhh, what an excellent hot spring. I could relax in
here forever...

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>, what’s that you’ve got
there?
<$voicel(1,6)>Of course, of course.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)>You’re giving it to me? I promise I wasn’t trying to hint at
that—but thank you!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,8)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)>I really can’t thank you enough for all the things you do,
<$cdef(27)>. I like everything about you!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>! Why thank you! This is really quite
special!

<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Oof... I’m feeling a bit tuckered out. Walking long
distances takes a lot out of me. <$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>I believe I’ll stay here.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,9)>Urk... I’m not sure I’d even fit in this house. <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,1)>I’d feel much
more comfortable in a bigger one.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,13)><$kfacial(1)><$pkcry;0(1,3)>! Now this is an impressive house!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,6)>Would that really be all right? Then I’ll happily take you
up on the offer—thank you!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,48)><$facial(1,1)>Indeed. You make great things, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Wh-what’s that you say? I can really move into this house?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,6)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>! Thank you! I’m excited to start my new
life
in
this house!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Oh, all right, then. No, no—don’t worry about it!

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,9)>Hmmm... I’m not sure there’s enough space left in this
house for me to move in too... <$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)>I’d rather not impose!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Oho! Thanks for thinking of me, <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,1)>But that gift would be wasted on me. Why don’t you give it
to some other Pokémon?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>This is where I already live, <$cdef(27)><pname;1></color>!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,659)><$facial(1,4)>Well done, indeed, <$cdef(27)>! Good to
see
your
hard
work
paying off!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,667)><$voicel(1,3)>Hrmmm... Something about this place just doesn’t sit quite
right with me. <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>I don’t think I’ll move here after all!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,11)><$motion(1,665)>What in the world? My home’s up and gone missing!

<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,663)><$voicel(1,2)>I know you worked so hard to build that home,
<$cdef(27)>...

<$comeff(1,3)><$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,807)>*harrumph* Right, then! No use just standing around,
down in the dumps!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,664)>Time to clear my head and look for an even nicer home!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)><$facial(1,5)>Oho! What a splendid home! I’ll move in right away. <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,38)>Thank
you, <$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,10)>I feel so fortunate to live in this house!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>I can’t deny that this is an awfully fine place! In fact—yes!
I’ll move in here!

<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,4)>I’m terribly sorry, <$cdef(27)>, but I’m not
sure
I could
live
comfortably here.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Where do you think I ought to live?
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Is this my new home?

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>! It’s such a pleasure taking in the
morning sun!
<$comeff(1,21)><$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,668)>I can feel the warm energy soaking into me and my vines!

<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>I always get so hungry at this time of day. I wonder what
I should have for dinner tonight.
<$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>Maybe I’ll just have whatever you’re having,
<$cdef(27)>.

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,10)>Items made by humans are all so fascinating!
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Be sure to show me any you find, please. You’d make
this old Pokémon very happy!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>You’ve got quite the individual style to your
transformations, <$cdef(27)>. I like that!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>I hope you keep increasing your repertoire!

<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,3)>Sometimes it’s nice to just let your mind go blank and
stare off into the sky.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Recently I spent the entire day just wondering what
lies up beyond it.<$comcan(1)>

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,659)><$voicel(1,9)>Aren’t these glasses splendid? They’re my
greatest treasure.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,8)>I could never let anyone touch them—not even
you, <$cdef(27)>.

<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>I occasionally spend my free time doodling on the ground.
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m sure my scribbling isn’t up to human standards, but it’s
still surprisingly entertaining!

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>I’ve met so many more Pokémon thanks to you, <$voicel(1,8)>and made
a lot of new friends.<$comcan(1)>
<$comeff(1,8)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>But, my best friend of all is still you,
<$cdef(27)>.

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>If you’re looking for <$cdef(27)>,
I believe
they
may
be
over
that way!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Looking for <$cdef(27)>, are you?
I suppose
they
might
be
at home.

<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)><$cdef(27)>? So sorry, I’m afraid I
haven’t
seen
them today.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)><$cdef(27)>? I haven’t seen them around
here.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>Perhaps
their
home
is
somewhere
far away.

<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Hm? Are you searching for someone,
<$cdef(27)>?
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,3)>Ah, I see. It seems I was mistaken.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hmmm... That’s a good question! Where IS
<$cdef(27)>?
I’m
afraid
I
don’t know.

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,659)><$voicel(1,9)>Hohoho! So that was you, <$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Here, go on and take your <$cdef(27)><$ifull(532)>!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,659)><$voicel(1,9)>Hohoho! So that was you, <$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Here, go on and take your <$cdef(27)><$ifull(532)>!
